agenda: model-quality; defect 4 (incumbent efficiency), stage 0: re-anchor under the current convention
question: Does the soft-slice incumbent's in-distribution advantage (historically 2.34x per-parameter at matched 9.6M) persist against the current canonical MeshTransformer (homogeneous flagship, measure-consistent convention), and how does the incumbent behave zero-shot on foreign families under the same paired instrument?

known.historical_anchor: GeoTransolver ~9.5M params, matched recipe protocol, in-family 0.00249 (training-metric scale) vs MT x2L8 extrapolated 0.005828 at 9.6M -- measured 2.34x per-parameter gap, mechanism (learned soft-slice global exchange) never localized
known.current_mt_baseline: homog_fixed seeds 42-44 (flagship, 784k params): in-family 10k val rel-L2 0.1907/0.2058/0.2093; zero-shot smoke bounded on both SHIFT families (means 0.88-1.37)
known.asymmetry_declared: stage 0 compares standard configs (GT ~9.5M vs MT 784k, ~12x params); a matched-parameter MT rung is stage 1 IF the gap persists

protocol: recipe defaults, identical to the stage-1 lanes: 500 epochs, lr 3e-3, StepLR 100/0.1, bf16, batch 1, augment=false, 4-GPU single-node DDP on AGA; no per-model tuning in either direction
instrument: identical paired instrument to stage 1: in-family drivaer_ml val 5-resolution sweep (pdmsh rel-L2 + rms ratio) and zero-shot smoke on SHIFT estate+fastback val (metrics.jsonl normalized pressure_l2)

deciding_gates.D1_infamily_anchor: GT 10k val mean rel-L2, 3 seeds, vs MT homog flagship's 0.191-0.209. DECISION RULE: if GT (at 12x params) does not beat the MT flagship by more than 1.10x on the seed-mean, the historical incumbent advantage is declared not-reproduced under the current convention and defect 4 closes without a mechanism hunt; if GT is materially better (>1.25x), stage 1 preregisters the matched-parameter rung / mechanism-absorption experiment; between 1.10x and 1.25x, stage 1 is a matched-parameter rung before any mechanism claim
deciding_gates.D2_boundedness_paired: GT zero-shot pressure_l2 finite and mean < 3.0 on both families, per seed -- quantifies the historical 'generic baseline stays structured' claim with 3 fresh seeds under the paired instrument
deciding_gates.D3_resolution_transfer_paired: GT 40k/10k rel-L2 ratio, descriptive -- GT has no quadrature-measure pathway, so this measures whether resolution robustness is architecture-generic or convention-bought

predictions.D1: GT beats MT flagship in-family at 12x params (p ~ 0.7); GT beats by >1.25x triggering stage 1 (p ~ 0.45)
predictions.D2: GT bounded on both families 3/3 seeds (p ~ 0.65)

falsifier: If GT under the identical protocol lands at or below MT-flagship accuracy in-family, the 2.34x anchor was a property of the old convention/mode, not of the architectures, and the defect-4 mechanism hunt is cancelled as moot.
